title: Primarina-Ping and Aqua Ping playing in the sea
prompt:
Create ONE complete portrait-oriented printable children's COLORING BOOK COMIC PAGE with EXACTLY FOUR PANELS in a clean equal 2-by-2 grid, strong simple rectangular black panel borders, wide white gutters and an outer white print margin. Page proportions approximately A4 portrait. NO TEXT ANYWHERE, no letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, sound effects, title, watermark or logos.

The two recurring characters are:
Reference image 1: PRIMARINA-PING. Preserve her huge rounded head and tiny mermaid body, swept wavy forelock, long curled high ponytail with large pearl beads, five-point star beside her face, fin-shaped hair crest, little scalloped collar, short flipper arms, curved mermaid tail and fan-shaped tail fin.
Reference image 2: AQUA PING. Preserve her huge rounded fox-like head and tiny mermaid body, two large upright triangular fox ears, short wavy forelock, fan-shaped gills at both cheeks, small fox muzzle, little flipper arms, curved tail with dorsal fins and broad two-lobed tail fluke.
Use references ONLY for shape and identity. Translate them into slightly simplified black-and-white coloring-book LINE ART, not 3D rendering. Keep the characters easy to distinguish in every panel: Primarina always has the pearl ponytail and star; Aqua always has upright fox ears and cheek-gill fans. Both are cheerful friendly cute creatures.

Four wordless scenes of the SAME TWO characters playing in the sea:
Top left: Both bob at the sea surface and happily splash each other with their little arms, a few large outlined droplets and gentle waves, one simple cloud above.
Top right: Underwater, Primarina blows several LARGE round bubbles and Aqua playfully chases and taps one; graceful swimming poses, two simple fish far behind.
Bottom left: Both play catch with a large striped beach ball at the water's surface, the ball between their raised hands, a few rounded wave curves. Clear anatomy and happy expressions.
Bottom right: Underwater, both build a small sandcastle together on the seabed, one placing a shell on top while the other pats a turret, a few simple seashells and two sparse seaweed fronds around them.

STYLE AND PRINT CONSTRAINTS: pure BLACK ink contours on a PURE WHITE opaque background. No color, NO GRAY, no shading, no gradients, no hatching, no stippling, no textures, no shadows, no large solid black fills. Eyes should have outlined pupils/irises with large WHITE interiors for coloring, not solid black discs. Medium-bold smooth outer lines, fewer thinner interior lines, closed clean shapes, generous large open areas to color, uncluttered simple scenery. Simplify pearl count and hair strands while retaining identities. Cute rounded expressive faces; readable joyful action. Both characters appear fully and clearly inside EACH of the FOUR panels. No extra limbs, merged hands or cropped ears/tails. Consistent character design across panels. Crisp professional coloring-book outlines, not sketchy pencil strokes. Deliver a single finished page ready to print and color.
